summary.text: Jared Solomon is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 18 who has served since January 9, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Solomon succeeded Jeff Waldstreicher in the House of Delegates and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him as House Chair of the Audit and Evaluation Committee and a member of the Children, Youth, and Families Committee and the Appropriations Committee.
